$comment: Enlift Agent Template — permissions baseline. DO NOT loosen these without team review. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).
$note: Enlift baseline: defaultMode=deny means every tool not listed here is blocked. Read is scoped to the project directory. Git write ops (add/commit/push) are NOT in the baseline — an injection-hijacked agent must not be able to exfiltrate data via git. Derived agents that genuinely need git write access must add these permissions explicitly with a documented justification. Destructive ops (force push, hard reset, rebase) remain denied.
$extensions: To add external tools for your agent (MCP servers, CLI tools, APIs), add them to the allow list in a PR and document the justification in your CLAUDE.md. Examples: 'mcp__atlassian__*', 'mcp__slack__*', 'Bash(python3 src/*.py)', 'Bash(node src/index.js)'
